findings: All18 current site matches show the collected exact legal-name and checksum-valid org proof, including separate contact/about pages where needed. One verified website has no substantive extracted facts.

Prior Avero quoted-installer and Solund parent-CEO contacts are absent from the selected current contact claims. BMV and Temp-Team now use actual home business paragraphs rather than privacy copy; El-IT now uses its electrical-services paragraph rather than navigation/advisory title.

Temp-Team cross-domain privacy contact was specifically investigated in the original collected policy: the exact Temp-Team controller/org section explicitly invites contact at that mailbox for privacy questions. It is a privacy contact, not evidence of a new company relationship or a generic parent CEO.

Two descriptions have limited usefulness: an ecological-organisation recruitment introduction is secondary to its genuine home description; the gold buyer excerpt describes insured postage rather than a comprehensive business summary. They remain attributed literal excerpts; no dated/current job or named product is inferred. This is a relevance limitation, not a measured error-rate claim.
Verified NEMS contacts use its own business domain; Fjellfix address and Fjordweb alternate name are exact-entity structured observations. No group facts were inherited by every subsidiary.
limitations: No independent human reviewer or private checked reference pool
This review does not establish precision across rejected candidates, every registered role or all financial periods
Company snippets/raw source bodies remain private; this public review contains access URLs/hashes and inspection metadata only

Two dated records are framed only as articles published on the verified company site, not as inferred launches or current vacancies.
Fo-Tec description is a product-category-rich but poorly formatted/truncated literal source fragment. Retained as attributed content; quality limitation explicitly recorded.
Recovery and selected each find five substantive companies; zero verified-host overlap with recorded presealed runs. No breadth gain or generalisation benefit is claimed from this sample.

The recovery control correctly extracts two genuine West Mekan B2B offerings (passenger seats and propeller systems). The selected purchase-control-or-exact-provider rule withholds both, a known false-negative tradeoff for non-checkout industrial catalogues. It is not claimed as a precision improvement, and no post-sealed tuning was performed.
